infobox.usage: Unlocks the meeting room on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup meeting room key (TG meeting) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the meeting room at the TerraGroup office.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest The Secret Recipe

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Meeting room on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building at Streets of Tarkov.
